text: Anne-Robert-Jacques Turgot was born in Paris on the 10th of May 1727.
zh: 安妮·罗伯特·雅克·杜尔哥 1727 年 5 月 10 日出生于巴黎。
chunks: Anne-Robert-Jacques Turgot was born
in Paris on the 10th of May 1727.

text: His life covered rather more than half a century, extending, if we may put it a little roughly, over the middle fifty years of the eighteenth century.
zh: 他的一生足足有半个多世纪，粗略地说，跨过十八世纪中五十年。
chunks: His life covered rather more
than half a century, extending,
if we may put it a little roughly,
over the middle fifty years
of the eighteenth century.

text: At its beginning neither the intellectual nor the social elements of the great disruption had distinctly appeared, or commenced their fermentation.
zh: 在这场大混乱开始时，知识分子和社会因素都没有明显出现，也没有开始发酵。
chunks: At its beginning neither the intellectual
nor the social elements
of the great disruption had distinctly appeared,
or commenced their fermentation.

text: It was between 1727 and 1781 that the true revolution took place.
zh: 真正的革命发生在 1727 年至 1781 年间。
chunks: It was
between 1727 and 1781 that the true revolution took place.

text: In 1727 Voltaire was returning from his exile in England, to open the long campaign, of which he was from that time forth to the close of his days the brilliant and indomitable captain.
zh: 1727年，伏尔泰从英国流放归来，开始了漫长的战役，从那时起直到晚年，他一直是这场战役中才华横溢、不屈不挠的队长。
chunks: In 1727 Voltaire was returning
from his exile in England,
to open the long campaign, of which he was
from that time forth to the close
of his days the brilliant and indomitable captain.

text: Thus Turgot's life was almost exactly contemporary with the pregnant era of Voltaire's activity.
zh: 因此，杜尔哥的生活几乎与伏尔泰活动的孕育时代完全同时发生。
chunks: Thus Turgot's life was almost exactly contemporary
with the pregnant era of Voltaire's activity.

text: It will be observed, moreover, that Turgot was born half a generation after the first race of the speculative revolutionists.
zh: 此外，我们还可以看出，杜尔哥是在第一届投机革命者诞生半代之后出生的。
chunks: It will be observed, moreover,
that Turgot was born half a generation after the first race
of the speculative revolutionists.

text: Diderot, Helvetius, Condillac, D'Alembert, as well as the foreign Hume, so much the greatest of the whole band of innovators, because penetrating so much nearer to the depths, all came into the world which they were to confuse so unspeakably, in the half dozen years between 1711 and 1717.
chunks: Diderot, Helvetius, Condillac, D'Alembert, as well
as the foreign Hume, so much the greatest
of the whole band of innovators, because penetrating so much nearer
to the depths, all came into the world which they were
to confuse so unspeakably, in the half dozen years between 1711 and 1717.

text: We cannot tell how far the gulf between Turgot and the earlier band was fixed by the accident that he did not belong to their generation in point of time.
zh: 我们无法判断杜尔哥和早期乐队之间的鸿沟有多大，因为他在时间上不属于他们这一代。
chunks: We cannot tell
how far the gulf between Turgot
and the earlier band was fixed
by the accident that he did not belong
to their generation in point of time.

text: The years of Turgot exactly bridge the interval between the ministry of the infamous Dubois and the ministry of the inglorious Calonne; between the despair and confusion of the close of the regency, and the despair and confusion of the last ten years of the monarchy.
chunks: The years of Turgot exactly bridge the interval
between the ministry of the infamous Dubois
and the ministry of the inglorious Calonne;
between the despair and confusion of the close of the regency,
and the despair and confusion of the last ten years of the monarchy.

text: In 1781 we emerge from these subterranean realms into the open air, to find ourselves surrounded by all the sounds and portents of imminent ruin.
zh: 1781 年，我们从这些地下王国来到露天，发现自己被即将毁灭的所有声音和预兆所包围。
chunks: In 1781 we emerge from these subterranean realms
into the open air,
to find ourselves surrounded
by all the sounds
and portents of imminent ruin.

text: His stock was Norman, and those who amuse themselves by finding a vital condition of the highest ability in antiquity of blood, may quote the descent of Turgot in support of their delusion.
zh: 他的血统是诺曼，而那些以发现古代血统最高能力的重要条件为乐的人，可能会引用杜尔哥的血统来支持他们的妄想。
chunks: His stock was Norman, and those who amuse themselves
by finding a vital condition
of the highest ability in antiquity of blood,
may quote the descent
of Turgot in support of their delusion.

text: Let us pass over Togut and Saint Turgot; and the founder of a hospital in the thirteenth century; and the great-great-grandfather who sat as president of the Norman nobles in the States-General of 1614, and the grandfather who deserted arms for the toga.
chunks: Let us pass over Togut and Saint Turgot; and the founder
of a hospital in the thirteenth century;
and the great-great-grandfather who sat as president
of the Norman nobles in the States-General of 1614,
and the grandfather who deserted arms for the toga.

text: History is hardly concerned in this solemn marshalling of shades.
zh: 历史几乎不关心这种庄严的色调排列。
chunks: History is hardly concerned
in this solemn marshalling of shades.

text: France to Don Philip of Spain (August 1739).
zh: 法国致西班牙的唐·菲利普（Don Philip）（1739 年 8 月）。
chunks: France to Don Philip
of Spain (August 1739).

text: We see certain wild animals, male and female, scattered over the fields, black, livid, all burnt by the sun, bound to the earth that they dig and work with unconquerable pertinacity; they have a sort of articulate voice, and when they rise on their feet, they show a human face; in fact they are men.
chunks: We see certain wild animals, male and female, scattered over the fields, black, livid,
all burnt by the sun, bound to the earth
that they dig and work with unconquerable pertinacity; they have a sort
of articulate voice, and when they rise
on their feet, they show a human face; in fact they are men.

text: There have been noble and patriotic men who lacked this inheritance, but we may be sure that even these would have fought the battle at greater advantage, if a magnanimous preference for the larger interests had come to them as a matter of instinctive prejudice, instead of being acquired as a matter of reason.
chunks: There have been noble and patriotic men
who lacked this inheritance, but we may be sure
that even these would have fought the battle at greater advantage, if a magnanimous preference
for the larger interests had come to them as a matter
of instinctive prejudice, instead of being acquired as a matter of reason.

text: And Turgot's family was only of the secondary noblesse of the robe.
zh: 而杜尔哥家族也只是袍子的次等贵族。
chunks: And Turgot's family was only
of the secondary noblesse of the robe.

text: As the employments which persons of respectable family could enter were definite and stereotyped, there was little room for debate as to the calling for which a youth should prepare himself.
zh: 由于出身名门的人可以从事的职业是明确的、固定的，所以对于年轻人应该为自己的职业做好准备几乎没有争论的余地。
chunks: As the employments which persons
of respectable family could enter were definite
and stereotyped, there was little room
for debate as to the calling
for which a youth should prepare himself.

text: Arms, civil administration, and the church, furnished the only three openings for a gentleman.
zh: 武器、民政和教堂是绅士仅有的三个机会。
chunks: Arms,
civil administration,
and the church,
furnished the only three openings
for a gentleman.

text: To identify the interests of the richest and most powerful class with the interests of the church, of the army, and of a given system of civil government, was indeed to give to that class the strongest motives for leaving the existing social order undisturbed.
chunks: To identify the interests of the richest
and most powerful class with the interests of the church,
of the army, and of a given system
of civil government, was indeed to give to that class the strongest motives
for leaving the existing social order undisturbed.

text: Some of its evil effects were obvious and on the surface.
zh: 它的一些邪恶影响是显而易见的、表面上的。
chunks: Some of its evil effects were obvious
and on the surface.

text: Vauvenargues, who was born for diplomacy or literature, passed the flower of his days in the organised dreariness of garrisons and marches.
zh: 沃韦纳尔格是为外交或文学而生的，他在有组织的、沉闷的驻军和行军中度过了他的黄金时代。
chunks: Vauvenargues, who was born
for diplomacy or literature,
passed the flower of his days
in the organised dreariness
of garrisons and marches.

text: France, until a very short time before the Revolution, we can hardly point to a single recognised usage which did not augment this waste.
zh: 在法国，直到大革命前不久，我们几乎找不到任何一种公认的用法不会增加这种浪费。
chunks: France, until a very short time
before the Revolution,
we can hardly point
to a single recognised usage
which did not augment this waste.

text: Turgot's eldest brother was to devote himself to civil administration, the next to be a soldier, and Turgot himself to be an ecclesiastic.
zh: 杜尔哥的长兄将致力于民政管理，其次是一名军人，杜尔哥本人则成为一名牧师。
chunks: Turgot's eldest brother was to devote himself
to civil administration, the next
to be a soldier,
and Turgot himself
to be an ecclesiastic.

text: The second of the brothers, who began by following arms, had as little taste for them as the future minister had for the church.
zh: 兄弟中的第二个，从跟随武器开始，对他们没有兴趣，就像未来的牧师对教会没有兴趣一样。
chunks: The second of the brothers,
who began by following arms,
had as little taste for them
as the future minister had
for the church.

text: Governor-general, but he had forgotten to take the climate into account, and the scheme came to an abortive end, involving him in a mass of confused quarrels which lasted some years.
zh: 总督，但他忘记了考虑气候，这个计划最终流产，让他卷入了持续数年的一系列混乱的争吵。
chunks: Governor-general, but he had forgotten
to take the climate into account,
and the scheme came to an abortive end,
involving him in a mass
of confused quarrels which lasted some years.

text: The affection of one biographer records how the pocket-money with which the young Turgot was furnished, used always instantly to disappear, no one knew how nor on what.
chunks: The affection of one biographer records
how the pocket-money
with which the young Turgot was furnished,
used always instantly to disappear,
no one knew how nor on what.

text: It is less pleasant to learn that Turgot throughout his childhood was always repulsed by his mother, who deemed him sullen, because he failed to make his bow with good grace, and was shy and taciturn.
zh: 令人不愉快的是，杜尔哥在整个童年时期都受到母亲的排斥，母亲认为他闷闷不乐，因为他不能优雅地鞠躬，而且害羞而沉默寡言。
chunks: It is less pleasant to learn
that Turgot throughout his childhood was always repulsed
by his mother, who deemed him sullen,
because he failed to make his bow
with good grace, and was shy and taciturn.

text: [Footnote 3: _Vie de Turgot_, p.
zh: [脚注 3：_Vie de Turgot_，第 14 页
chunks: [Footnote 3:
_Vie de Turgot_, p.

zh: [脚注 5：写给格拉菲尼夫人的信。 _OEuv._ ii.
chunks: [Footnote 5:
Lettre a Madame de Graffigny. _OEuv._ ii.

text: Morellet, one of the best known of the little group of friends and brother students at the Sorbonne, has recorded other authentic traits.
zh: 莫雷莱是索邦大学的一小群朋友和兄弟学生中最著名的人之一，他还记录了其他真实的特征。
chunks: Morellet, one of the best known
of the little group
of friends and brother students
at the Sorbonne,
has recorded other authentic traits.

text: His modesty and reserve were those of a girl, and those equivocal references in which the undisciplined animalism of youth often has a stealthy satisfaction, always called the blood to his cheeks and covered him with embarrassment.
zh: 他的谦逊和矜持是女孩的风格，而那些模棱两可的提及，其中年轻人不守纪律的兽性往往有一种隐秘的满足感，总是让他脸颊热血沸腾，让他感到尴尬。
chunks: His modesty and reserve were those
of a girl, and those equivocal references in which the undisciplined animalism
of youth often has a stealthy satisfaction,
always called the blood to his cheeks
and covered him with embarrassment.

text: We may be glad to know this, because without express testimony to the contrary, there would have been some reason for suspecting that Turgot was defective in that most wholesome and human quality of a capacity for laughter.
zh: 我们可能会很高兴知道这一点，因为如果没有明确的相反证据，我们就有理由怀疑杜尔哥在笑的能力这一最健康、最人性的品质方面有缺陷。
chunks: We may be glad to know this,
because without express testimony to the contrary,
there would have been some reason for suspecting that Turgot was defective
in that most wholesome and human quality
of a capacity for laughter.

text: This was the more remarkable from the prevailing laxity of opinion upon this particular subject, perhaps the worst blemish upon the feeling and intelligence of the revolutionary schools.
zh: 就这一特定主题普遍存在的宽松观点而言，这一点更为引人注目，这也许是革命学校的情感和智力上最严重的缺陷。
chunks: This was the more remarkable
from the prevailing laxity of opinion
upon this particular subject, perhaps the worst blemish
upon the feeling and intelligence
of the revolutionary schools.

text: But the fact that such a restriction should have been noticed, suggests that it was exceptional.[7] One good effect followed, let us admit.
chunks: But the fact
that such a restriction should have been noticed,
suggests that it was exceptional.[7] One good effect followed,
let us admit.

text: It was permitted to occupy no solitary and mysterious throne, apart and away from other conditions and parts of human excellence and social wellbeing.
zh: 它不被允许占据任何孤立和神秘的王位，远离人类卓越和社会福祉的其他条件和部分。
chunks: It was permitted
to occupy no solitary
and mysterious throne, apart and away
from other conditions and parts
of human excellence and social wellbeing.

text: On the contrary, there is a multitude of practical advantages in such a consolidated and spontaneously working order.
zh: 相反，这种统一且自发的工作秩序具有许多实际优势。
chunks: On the contrary,
there is a multitude
of practical advantages
in such a consolidated
and spontaneously working order.

text: But in considering conduct and character, and forming an opinion upon infractions of a virtue, we cannot be just unless we have analysed its conditions, and this is what the eighteenth century did defectively with regard to that particular virtue which so often usurps the name of all of the virtues together.
chunks: But in considering conduct and character, and forming an opinion upon infractions of a virtue,
we cannot be just unless we have analysed its conditions,
and this is what the eighteenth century did defectively
with regard to that particular virtue which so often usurps the name
of all of the virtues together.

text: [Footnote 6: Letter to Turgot, _OEuv. de Condorcet_, i.
zh: [脚注 6：给杜尔哥的信，_OEuv。德孔多塞_，i。
chunks: [Footnote 6:
Letter to Turgot,
_OEuv. de Condorcet_, i.

text: He could retain as many as a hundred and eighty lines of verse, after hearing them twice, or sometimes even once.
zh: 一百八十行诗句，听两遍，有时听一遍就能记住。
chunks: He could retain as many
as a hundred
and eighty lines of verse,
after hearing them twice,
or sometimes even once.

text: His predominant characteristics are described as penetration, and that other valuable faculty to which penetration is an indispensable adjunct, but which it by no means invariably implies--a spirit of broad and systematic co-ordination.
zh: 他的主要特征被描述为洞察力，以及其他有价值的能力，洞察力是不可或缺的辅助手段，但它绝不总是意味着广泛而系统的协调精神。
chunks: His predominant characteristics are described as penetration,
and that other valuable faculty
to which penetration is an indispensable adjunct,
but which it by no means invariably implies--a spirit
of broad and systematic co-ordination.

text: It has been justly said of him that he passed at once from infancy to manhood, and was in the rank of sages before he had shaken off the dust of the playground.
zh: 据说他从小到大，还没抖掉操场上的灰尘，就已经是圣人了。
chunks: It has been justly said
of him that he passed
at once from infancy to manhood, and was
in the rank of sages before he had shaken
off the dust of the playground.

text: Of this temperament was Turgot in a superlative degree, and its fire never abated in him from college days, down to the last hours while he lay racked with irremediable anguish.
zh: 杜尔哥的这种气质达到了最高程度，从大学时代起，一直到他在无法挽回的痛苦中度过的最后几个小时，这种气质在他身上从未减弱过。
chunks: Of this temperament was Turgot in a superlative degree,
and its fire never abated
in him from college days,
down to the last hours
while he lay racked with irremediable anguish.

text: To a certain extent this was the glorious mark of all the best minds of the epoch; from Voltaire downwards, they were inflamed by an inextinguishable and universal curiosity.
chunks: To a certain extent this was the glorious mark
of all the best minds
of the epoch; from Voltaire downwards,
they were inflamed by an inextinguishable
and universal curiosity.

text: Rousseau wrote a comic opera and was an ardent botanist.
zh: 卢梭写过一部喜剧，也是一位热心的植物学家。
chunks: Rousseau wrote a comic opera
and was an ardent botanist.

text: The society of the Sorbonne corresponded exactly to a college at one of our universities, and will be distinguished by the careful reader from the faculty of theology in the university, which was usually, but not always, composed of _docteurs de Sorbonne_.
chunks: The society of the Sorbonne corresponded exactly to a college at one
of our universities, and will be distinguished
by the careful reader from the faculty of theology
in the university, which was usually,
but not always, composed of _docteurs de Sorbonne_.

text: Newtonian principles of astronomy, instead of the Cartesian hypothesis of vortices.
zh: 牛顿天文学原理，而不是笛卡尔涡旋假设。
chunks: Newtonian principles
of astronomy,
instead of the Cartesian hypothesis
of vortices.

text: He appears to have had no peculiar or natural aptitude for this study; though he is said to have constantly blamed himself for not having gone more deeply into it.
zh: 他似乎对这项研究没有特殊或天生的天赋。尽管据说他一直责怪自己没有更深入地研究它。
chunks: He appears to have had no peculiar
or natural aptitude for this study;
though he is said
to have constantly blamed himself
for not having gone more deeply into it.

text: The precision, definiteness, and accurate limitations of the method of the one, are usually unfriendly to the brooding, tentative, uncircumscribed meditation which is the productive humour in the other.
zh: 一种方法的精确性、明确性和准确的局限性，通常对沉思、试探性、不受限制的冥想是不友好的，而这种冥想是另一种方法的富有成效的幽默。
chunks: The precision, definiteness, and accurate limitations
of the method of the one,
are usually unfriendly
to the brooding, tentative, uncircumscribed meditation
which is the productive humour in the other.

text: Turgot was essentially of the philosophising temper.
zh: 杜尔哥本质上具有哲学气质。
chunks: Turgot was essentially
of the philosophising temper.

text: When he applied to work,' says Morellet, 'when it was a question of writing or doing, he was slow and loitering.
zh: 当他申请工作时，”莫雷尔特说，“当涉及到写作或做事的问题时，他动作缓慢且闲逛。
chunks: When he applied to work,
' says Morellet,
'when it was a question
of writing or doing,
he was slow and loitering.

zh: [脚注 9：_OEuv。德·杜尔哥_，ii。
chunks: [Footnote 9:
_OEuv. de Turgot_, ii.

text: Another member of the circle was Lomenie de Brienne, who, in long years after, was chief minister of France for a narrow space through the momentous winter of 1787 and the spring of the next year, filling the gap between Calonne and Necker in a desperate and fatal manner.
chunks: Another member of the circle was Lomenie de Brienne,
who, in long years after, was chief minister of France
for a narrow space through the momentous winter
of 1787 and the spring of the next year, filling the gap

text: Though quite without means, he planned this in his visions on a scale of extreme costliness and magnificence.
chunks: Though quite without means,
he planned this
in his visions
on a scale
of extreme costliness and magnificence.

text: Money came to the family, and the chateau was built exactly as he had projected it, at a cost of two million francs.[13] His career was splendid.
zh: 钱来到了这个家庭，城堡完全按照他的计划建造，耗资 200 万法郎。 [13]他的职业生涯非常辉煌。
chunks: Money came to the family,
and the chateau was built exactly
as he had projected it,
at a cost
of two million francs.[13] His career was splendid.

text: an Archbishop of Paris must at least believe in God.
zh: 巴黎大主教至少必须信仰上帝。
chunks: an Archbishop
of Paris must at least believe in God.

text: His last official act was to send for the 20,000 livres for his month's salary, not fully due.
zh: 他最后的正式行动是领取 20,000 里弗的一个月工资，但尚未完全到期。
chunks: His last official act was
to send for the 20,
000 livres
for his month's salary,
not fully due.

text: He was a person of no talent, his friends allowed, but 'assisted by a good chief clerk, he would have made a good minister; he meant well.
zh: 他的朋友们承认，他是一个没有才华的人，但“如果有一个好的首席书记官的协助，他本可以成为一个好的部长；”他的本意是好的。
chunks: He was a person of no talent,
his friends allowed, but 'assisted
by a good chief clerk,
he would have made a good minister;
he meant well.

text: The hour, however, was just striking, and the knife was sharpened.
zh: 然而，时辰已过，刀已磨利。
chunks: The hour, however,
was just striking,
and the knife was sharpened.

zh: 当更糟糕的事情即将降临到他身上时，他在自己的宫殿里服毒自杀。
chunks: He poisoned himself
in his own palace,
just as a worse thing was
about to befall him.

text: Alas, poetic justice is the exception in history, and only once in many generations does the drama of the state criminal rise to an artistic fifth act.
zh: 唉，诗意的正义在历史上是个例外，国家罪犯的戏剧在许多代人中只有一次上升到艺术的第五幕。
chunks: Alas, poetic justice is the exception
in history, and only once
in many generations does the drama
of the state criminal rise
to an artistic fifth act.

text: The horror and disgrace of such a situation were too striking for one who used his mind and acted on principle, to run any risk of that situation becoming his own.
zh: 这种情况的恐怖和耻辱对于一个用自己的头脑并按原则行事的人来说太引人注目了，不能冒这种情况成为他自己的风险。
chunks: The horror and disgrace
of such a situation were too striking
for one who used his mind
and acted on principle, to run any risk
of that situation becoming his own.

text: Turgot was of other calibre, holding it to be only a degree less unprincipled than the avowed selfishness of the adventurer, to contract so serious an engagement on the strength of common hearsay and current usage, without deliberate personal reflection and inquiry.
chunks: Turgot was of other calibre, holding it
to be only a degree less unprincipled

on the strength of common hearsay and current usage,
without deliberate personal reflection and inquiry.

text: His father approved of the resolution, and gave the required consent.
zh: 他的父亲批准了该决议，并给予了必要的同意。
chunks: His father approved
of the resolution,
and gave the required consent.

text: His college friends had remonstrated warmly at this surrender of a brilliant prospect.
zh: 他的大学朋友们对他放弃美好前景提出了强烈抗议。
chunks: His college friends had remonstrated warmly
